en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view taken from an elevated lookout with a simple wooden railing in the foreground, overlooking a compact European town in a hilly rural landscape. The town is composed mainly of multi‑storey masonry houses with steep gabled roofs and a few church towers visible among the buildings. Fields and scattered farmhouses surround the settlement, and winding roads lead out into the countryside. The upper edge of the image appears damaged or overexposed, suggesting this is a reproduction of an old photographic postcard.
